cases.case_label: Retrotransposal insertion in FKTN in Korean patients
cases.mechanism_detail: In a Korean cohort, compound heterozygous FKTN genotypes combining a retrotransposal insertion with deep-intronic variants were most common and associated with severe phenotypes; insertion location, number of carriers and mechanism are not given in the abstract.
cases.quote: Compound heterozygous retrotransposal insertions and deep-intronic variants in FKTN were the most common genotypes and were associated with severe phenotypes.
